title: nf-schema - params.primer_params schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.primer_params

primers.description: Name of the PCR primer pair. Must be unique and match those given in the samplesheet.
primers.errorMessage: PCR primer names must not contain spaces, commas, semicolons or two underscores in a row.

locus.description: Name of the target locus. Does not have to be unique if two or more primer pairs amplify the same locus.
locus.errorMessage: Locus names must not contain spaces, commas or semicolons.

for_primer_seq.errorMessage: Forward primer sequence must contain only nucleotide characters ('GATCRYMKSWHBVDNI', upper or lower case) without spaces; multiple sequences may be separated by semicolons.

rev_primer_seq.errorMessage: Reverse primer sequence must contain only nucleotide characters ('GATCRYMKSWHBVDNI', upper or lower case) without spaces; multiple sequences may be separated by semicolons.

max_primer_mismatch.description: Maximum number of mismatches to allow when detecting primer sequences.
max_primer_mismatch.errorMessage: Maximum primer mismatches must be an integer >= 0.

read_min_length.description: Minimum allowed length of reads after primer trimming.
read_min_length.errorMessage: Minimum read length must be an integer >= 0.

read_max_length.description: Maximum allowed length of reads after primer trimming.
read_max_length.errorMessage: Maximum read length must be an integer >= 1, or 'Inf' for no maximum length.

read_max_ee.description: Maximum expected errors allowed in primer-trimmed reads.
read_max_ee.errorMessage: Maximum expected errors must be an integer >= 0.

read_trunc_length.description: Length to which all reads will be truncated, if longer.
read_trunc_length.errorMessage: Read truncation length must be an integer >= 1. or NA

read_trim_left.description: Trim this many bases from the left side of primer-trimmed reads.
read_trim_left.errorMessage: Left-trimming amount must be an integer >= 0.

read_trim_right.description: Trim this many bases from the right side of primer-trimmed reads.
read_trim_right.errorMessage: Right-trimming amount must be an integer >= 0.

asv_min_length.description: Minimum allowable length of each ASV.
asv_min_length.errorMessage: Minimum ASV length must be an integer >= 1.

asv_max_length.description: Maximum allowable length of each ASV.
asv_max_length.errorMessage: Maximum ASV length must be an integer >= 1.

concat_unmerged.description: Retain unmerged read pairs by concatenating them together separated by a string of 10 N bases.
concat_unmerged.errorMessage: Concatenate unmerged must be true or false.

genetic_code.description: Genetic code for the amplicon if it is a coding sequence. See Biostrings::GENETIC_CODE_TABLE. Set to 'NA' if the amplicon is not derived from a coding sequence.
genetic_code.errorMessage: Genetic code must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

coding.description: Whether the amplicon is derived from a coding sequence.
coding.errorMessage: Coding must be true or false.

phmm.description: Path to a profile Hidden Markov Model (pHMM) of the target amplicon sequence.
phmm.errorMessage: pHMM path must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

idtaxa_db.description: Path to a trained IDTAXA model.
idtaxa_db.errorMessage: IDTAXA model must exist, have the '.rds' extension, and have a path without spaces or commas.

ref_fasta.description: Path to the reference database file.
ref_fasta.errorMessage: Reference database must exist, have a '.fa', '.fasta', '.fa.gz' or '.fasta.gz' extension, and have a path without spaces or commas.

idtaxa_confidence.errorMessage: IDTAXA minimum bootstrap confidence must be an integer between 0 and 100, inclusive.

run_blast.description: Whether to run a BLAST search in addition to IDTAXA.
run_blast.errorMessage: BLAST run must be true or false.

blast_min_identity.description: Minimum nucleotide identity percentage for taxonomic assignment using BLAST.
blast_min_identity.errorMessage: BLAST minimum identity must be an integer between 0 and 100, inclusive.

blast_min_coverage.description: Minimum query coverage percentage for taxonomic assignment using BLAST.
blast_min_coverage.errorMessage: BLAST minimum coverage must be an integer between 0 and 100, inclusive.

cluster_threshold.description: Cluster threshold can be used to cluster ASVs derived from each primer into groups (ie. OTUs).
cluster_threshold.errorMessage: Cluster threshold must be a number between 1 and 100 inclusive, or NA

target_kingdom.description: Filter output ASVs to those within this taxonomic kingdom.
target_kingdom.errorMessage: Target kingdom must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

target_phylum.description: Filter output ASVs to those within this taxonomic phylum.
target_phylum.errorMessage: Target phylum must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

target_class.description: Filter output ASVs to those within this taxonomic class.
target_class.errorMessage: Target class must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

target_order.description: Filter output ASVs to those within this taxonomic order.
target_order.errorMessage: Target order must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

target_family.description: Filter output ASVs to those within this taxonomic family.
target_family.errorMessage: Target family must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

target_genus.description: Filter output ASVs to those within this taxonomic genus.
target_genus.errorMessage: Target genus must be nonempty and must not contain spaces or commas.

target_species.description: Filter output ASVs to those within this taxonomic species. Spaces are permitted for binomial names.
target_species.errorMessage: Target species must contain at least one non-whitespace character and must not contain commas.

min_sample_reads.description: Minimum reads per sample to pass the filter.
min_sample_reads.errorMessage: Minimum reads per sample must be an integer >= 0.

min_taxa_reads.description: Minimum reads per ASV or taxon to pass the filter.
min_taxa_reads.errorMessage: Minimum reads per ASV or taxon must be an integer >= 0.

min_taxa_ra.description: Minimum relative abundance per ASV or taxon to pass the filter. Expressed as a proportion: 0.01 = 1%. Scientific notation, such as 1e-04, is allowed.
min_taxa_ra.errorMessage: Minimum relative abundance must be a number between 0 and 1, inclusive.
